content: Lactate/threshold HR commonly falls at 85-92% of max HR in trained runners; 90% (D-02's proposed max HR x 0.90) sits centrally in that range and is a defensible single-point estimate. Age-based max-HR fallback (220-age) is the classic Fox formula -- widely used but has a known +-10-12 bpm standard error per individual; acceptable as a soft, warn-don't-block estimate per D-03, not as a precise value.
